title.en: NutriChatBot — Intelligent Nutrition & Diet Assistant with Hybrid RAG
title.id: NutriChatBot — Asisten Nutrisi & Pola Makan Cerdas dengan Hybrid RAG

domain.en: AI Nutrition & Health Assistant / Generative RAG
domain.id: Asisten Gizi & Kesehatan Berbasis AI / Generative RAG

summary.en: Production-grade nutritional assistant combining dense ChromaDB embeddings and lexical SQLite search via Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, powering verified dietary advice and Mifflin-St Jeor metabolic calculations via GLM-5.3-flash reasoning.
summary.id: Asisten nutrisi teruji yang memadukan pencarian semantik ChromaDB dan leksikal SQLite melalui Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, menghadirkan saran gizi berbasis data resmi pangan dan kalkulator metabolik Mifflin-St Jeor dengan penalaran GLM-5.3-flash.

problem.en: General-purpose LLMs frequently hallucinate nutritional values and lack contextual knowledge of authentic Indonesian dietary staples (DKBM data), while users lack accessible tools for calculating clinically sound BMR/TDEE metabolic targets with medical safety guardrails.
problem.id: LLM umum kerap mengalami halusinasi pada data takaran nutrisi dan minim memahami komposisi bahan pangan lokal Indonesia (DKBM), sementara masyarakat kekurangan alat terpadu untuk menghitung target metabolik BMR/TDEE berbasis standar klinis yang dilengkapi batasan keselamatan medis.

personalContribution.en: Designed and engineered the end-to-end architecture: implemented the Dual-Engine Hybrid RAG with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF), integrated Mifflin-St Jeor metabolic formula, implemented medical risk detection guardrails and log redaction filters, refactored the multi-turn Streamlit conversational UI, and established 100% passing automated test coverage with GitHub Actions CI.
personalContribution.id: Merancang dan membangun arsitektur menyeluruh: mengimplementasikan Hybrid RAG Dual-Engine dengan Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF), mengintegrasikan kalkulator metabolik formula Mifflin-St Jeor, membangun guardrail deteksi risiko medis dan filter redaksi log sensitif, merekayasa antarmuka percakapan streaming Streamlit, serta mendirikan cakupan pengujian otomatis berstatus 100% lulus pada GitHub Actions CI.

engineeringFocus.en: Dual-engine hybrid retrieval with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF) fusing vector cosine distance and lexical rank scoring; real-time streaming token generation; strict regex-based sensitive credential redaction; comprehensive 51-test verification pyramid.
engineeringFocus.id: Hybrid retrieval dual-engine dengan Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF) yang menyatukan jarak kosinus vektor dan pemeringkatan leksikal; inferensi streaming token real-time; redaksi kredensial sensitif berbasis regex nir-bocor; serta piramida verifikasi 51 uji otomatis.

architecture.en: Layered architecture comprising Streamlit Web UI, Guardrails & Preprocessing Engine, Dual-Engine Retrieval Pipeline (Dense Semantic via ChromaDB + Lexical Ranked via SQLite), Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion Re-ranking, and SumoPod AI GLM-5.3-flash Streaming Inference.
architecture.id: Arsitektur berlapis yang terdiri atas Streamlit Web UI, Engine Guardrail & Pra-pemrosesan, Pipeline Retrieval Dual-Engine (Semantik Dense via ChromaDB + Leksikal Terurut via SQLite), Pemeringkatan Ulang Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, dan Inferensi Streaming SumoPod AI GLM-5.3-flash.

implementation.en: Built on Python 3.12 with clean service separation: services/database.py for parameterized SQLite queries, services/embeddings.py for text-embedding-3-small and ChromaDB vector operations, services/nutrition_calc.py for validated Mifflin-St Jeor math, services/llm.py for streaming GLM inference with safety guardrails, and app.py for multi-view Streamlit UI.
implementation.id: Dibangun di atas Python 3.12 dengan pemisahan modul yang rapi: services/database.py untuk kueri berparameter SQLite, services/embeddings.py untuk text-embedding-3-small dan ChromaDB, services/nutrition_calc.py untuk validasi formula Mifflin-St Jeor, services/llm.py untuk inferensi streaming GLM dengan guardrail medis, dan app.py untuk antarmuka multi-tampilan Streamlit.

technicalDecisions.decision: Hybrid Retrieval with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF)
technicalDecisions.rationale: Pure vector search struggles with exact Indonesian culinary naming (e.g., 'Beras giling merah' vs 'Beras ketan'), while pure keyword search fails on semantic queries (e.g., 'makanan tinggi protein rendah lemak'). wRRF with k=60 achieves the optimal balance of precision and recall.

technicalDecisions.decision: SumoPod AI Gateway with GLM-5.3-flash Model
technicalDecisions.rationale: Provides cost-effective, high-throughput inference with strong multi-step clinical reasoning and streaming token delivery via standard OpenAI-compatible client.

technicalDecisions.decision: Mifflin-St Jeor Equation for Biometric Calculation
technicalDecisions.rationale: Widely recognized by the American Dietetic Association (ADA) as the most clinically accurate predictive equation for resting metabolic rate in non-obese and obese individuals compared to legacy Harris-Benedict.

SQLite provides ACID compliance, fast exact-match lookups, and aggregate analytical capability, while ChromaDB provides localized persistent high-dimensional vector search without expensive cloud managed vector database overhead.

proof.testSuite: 51 automated pytest unit, integration, and UI tests (100% pass rate)
proof.qaSuite: 18 specialized QA end-to-end regression tests (18/18 passing)
proof.codeQuality: Ruff linter clean, zero lint errors, PEP 8 and typing compliance
proof.datasetSize: 1,346 verified Indonesian food items (100g standard basis)

limitations.en: Evaluated on local environments and comprehensive automated test suites; public multi-user production telemetry is unverified; AI responses serve educational guidance and strictly include medical disclaimers rather than substituting for certified clinical dietitian advice.
limitations.id: Diuji pada lingkungan lokal dan rangkaian pengujian otomatis komprehensif; telemetri produksi publik skala multi-pengguna belum terverifikasi; seluruh saran AI bersifat edukatif dan menyertakan disclaimer medis wajib, bukan pengganti konsultasi dokter gizi klinis berlisensi.
